## 2024-05-19 - Hardcoded exception leaks plaintext proxy passwords
**Vulnerability:** Proxy passwords were being leaked in plaintext through raw unhandled Python exception objects logged to the console, and unmasked proxy logs were dumping proxy credentials on the terminal.
**Learning:** Exceptions generated by third-party libraries (like requests) often dump raw connection URIs when connections fail, exposing basic auth credentials even if the script author didn't explicitly log the password.
**Prevention:** Always mask sensitive parts of URIs (like passwords in basic auth) using regex sanitize functions before logging exception text, and explicitly build masked connection string loggers rather than printing raw proxy definitions.
